text_block_list.text:
I visited a shrine with Admire Vega, 
hoping to give her a change of pace since 
she hasn't been feeling very well lately.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's quiet, isn't it?

Admire Vega looks up at the sky without 
saying a word. However, it felt like the 
tension surrounding her was gradually 
easing up.
choice_data_list: So what are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...The stars. Even if you can't see them 
during the day... they're still up there 
in the sky, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Oh, Ayabe-san and Trainer-san! 
What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Are you doing roadwork?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The course turns around here and 
heads back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you haven't yet, would you like to 
pray together? I always make it a point to 
stop by and pray!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass. I just came here for a change 
of pace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well then, I'm off to pray!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I pray that both Ayabe-san and I can face 
the race in absolute peak condition!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This is my wish! I really don't want any 
unexpected accidents or poor health to 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whether you can pull off a good run is 
entirely up to you, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be heading out first!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Good grief... ......"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Would you mind coming with 
me to visit the shrine?
choice_data_list:
Sure, but... I thought you weren't going 
to do that?

Sure, but... weren't you not going to do 
that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel a bit refreshed. Not feeling 
bad at all."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I just want to pay back what I owe.

Admire Vega spoke with a bright, refreshed 
look on her face. Afterward, the two of 
them said their prayers once more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Is that so...? Ah.

Just then, I thought I heard a rumbling 
sound coming from the distance.
(Pitter-patter... *craaaaash!*)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wah! Rain?!

In an instant, the sky darkened and heavy 
rain began to fall. Before long, the rain 
clouds drifted away, and clear skies 
returned.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It was really raining heavily. I'm glad it 
stopped soon, though... We still got 
soaked, didn't we?

The sudden rain ruined her attempt to 
refresh herself, leaving Admire Vega in 
poor shape.
